name: Mechanical clutch connection
summary: A clutch qualifier identifies a selectively coupled mechanical relationship.
description: A clutch qualifier identifies a selectively coupled mechanical relationship. A clutch provides a selectable mechanical relationship between driving and driven elements. Its engaged and disengaged conditions can influence movement without interrupting an electrical supply.
Name the two coupled elements and cross-reference the actuation and position feedback. Mechanical coupling does not imply that the elements share one electrical circuit.
readingNotes: Name the driving and driven elements and the coupling control.
Mechanical engagement does not mean electrical continuity between the elements.
